text:
Becca: FYI - DataBridge issued a mid-cycle rebate that was mistakenly applied, then taken off at billing. Vendor sent invoice after reversal. Need quick call on how to treat for Nov close (deferral vs accrual). Total rebate $31,600.

Tom: Is this a customer-facing discount we need to absorb or a vendor reimbursement?

Becca: Vendor reimbursement. Applied 2024-11-12, reversal 2024-11-16, vendor invoice dated 2024-11-20. Affected: 7 invoices; 5 are prepaid subscriptions, 2 are usage overages.

Sanjay: For usage overages we should reverse recognized revenue immediately. For prepaid subs, create a deferral and amortize over remaining subscription periods. Because vendor invoice exists and vendor confirmed payment within 45 days, we can record a vendor accrual.

Marta: Draft JEs for reviewer:
```
Dr Revenue Deferral (GL 2150) 31,600
  Cr Vendor Accrual (GL 2250) 31,600

Immediate reversal (usage overages total 6,900):
Dr Revenue (GL 4100) 6,900
  Cr Revenue Deferral (GL 2150) 6,900
```
Split for prepaid credits (24,700) to be amortized: two accounts have 10 months left, three accounts have 4 months left. Use month-weighted amort schedule per account.

Tom: Good. Please include per-invoice mapping, original invoice IDs, and a short amort table with monthly impact before routing. Any threshold approvals?

Becca: Per policy, amounts >$25k require FP&A notification and Finance Lead sign-off. I'll add FP&A and attach vendor email (PO DB-4317) and expected payment date 2024-12-09.

accounting-bot: Notice - month close freeze 2024-11-30 23:59 PST. Post adjustments by 2024-11-29 EOD for review.

Sanjay: I'll prepare the amort schedule (CSV) and the JE memo: "DataBridge rebate reversal - Nov close" and route to finance-leads@redwood.com. Becca, drop the vendor confirmation link here when uploaded.

Becca: Uploaded vendor email and invoice scan to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/FIN/DataBridge+rebate. Routing now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
